title: French Poffertjes Pancake
description: A French-inspired pancake recipe featuring poffertjes and a sweet, oily twist.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick frying pan or griddle over medium heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, eggs, milk, and melted butter until smooth.
Add the poffertjes to the batter and gently fold to combine.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the batter onto the preheated pan.
Cook the pancakes for 2-3 minutes, until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges start to dry.
Flip the pancakes and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
Serve the poffertjes pancakes hot with a drizzle of oily syrup.
Optional: top with additional syrup, whipped cream, or fresh fruit.
